grades.quote: For forward compatibility, base implementations shall ignore these fields, and standard software shall zero these fields.
grades.reason: The passage covers reserved fields in the FENCE instruction encoding (rs1, rd, fm, predecessor/successor sets), not control registers. It says standard software should zero reserved fields and use only non-reserved configurations. That is analogous to the query's reserved-field handling but doesn't address control registers or unsupported fields in them, so it is only limited auxiliary information.
